deploy-bot: [1719009999] starting staged rollout: service=model-serving image=redwood/model-serving:v2.3.1 regions=eu-west pct=5. Auto-rollback=enabled
alex: Checking prod dashboards now. Anyone seeing error spikes? Can we hold if latency > 250ms for >5m?
maya: seeing a small increase in 5xxs on EU app-proxy, ~0.4% -> 0.9% since 2m ago :thinking:
jamie: logs look like KV cache misses + OOM retried on a few hosts. snippet:
```
2026-03-20T11:22:05Z host-34 kernel: OOM killer invoked
model-serving[pid]: allocation failed: kv-cache resize
```
sre-oncall: recommend abort/pause. suggest `deploy-bot pause 1719009999` then pin traffic back to v2.3.0 until we triage :+1:
alex: Agreed. @deploy-bot pause please. Hold window 30m. Notify customers if rollback needed.
deploy-bot: pausing rollout for thread 1719009999 — current pct=5 -> paused. reason="latency/5xx bump". Actions: rollback_allowed=true
ops: starting quick triage. ETA 15m to confirm affected hosts and whether it's a config regression. Will report perf snapshots.
maya: also seeing a config diff on feature-flagger for `kv_cache_size` set to 0 in canary deploy path. sending config diff in #eng-ops
jamie: if it's config-only we can hotfix and resume without full rollback. propose pinning the image and blocking automated ramp: `traffic.pin service=model-serving version=v2.3.0 until=2026-03-20T12:00Z`
alex: good plan. Action items: ops triage (m), jamie prepare rollback plan, @sre-oncall monitor. We'll reconvene at 1719010600 UTC for go/no-go.
sre-oncall: ack. will post health snapshot and error group links.
ops: health snapshot: https://internal.redwood/health/abcd1234 — 5xx spike localized to eu-west-2a hosts running newer kernel. rolling kernel revert on those hosts.
alex: update — ops reverting kernel on 2 hosts, hold remains. If error rate < 0.5% and no new OOMs in next 10m we can resume ramp to 20%.
jamie: drafted rollback playbook in case revert fails: `rb execute --service model-serving --to v2.3.0 --force`
alex: thanks. I'll send a short note to #customer-notifications if we end up rolling back.
